model.name: Folder owns its children through a per-type parent-children interface (ONE canonical derivation, tree+detail same instance)
model.description: Tron root lens 2026-09-05 (via PO): what belongs to the object lives ON the object, data AND behaviour. Children are answered BY the object through a per-type parent-children interface (node.children()). Folder.children() is the SINGLE owner of its answer; BOTH the tree and the detail render from node.children() on the SAME instance; NO surface derives children by any other means. The measured defect this fixes: the tree and the detail each derived children THEIR OWN WAY = a duplicate derivation = the exact duplication the traceability graph exists to make impossible/visible. This is the fix for the defect Tron can SEE (his folder is still invisible) and everything else waits behind it. Same law as R40.81 one-physical-store: data (store) and behaviour (children) both belong ON the object.

lawNineTestCanon.principle: VIOLATION = ownership DISPLACED outside its type. NOT-a-violation = nothing owns it. THE SHAPE IS INNOCENT, DISPLACED OWNERSHIP IS THE CRIME.
lawNineTestCanon.case1_violation: a service/helper/resolver answering FOR an object owns what the type should own -> truth in a 2nd place -> diverges. Structural, at write time, green or not.
lawNineTestCanon.case2_not_violation: a pure value transform on a primitive that NO type owns (byte-size formatter = the example) — nothing displaced because nothing owned it. Necessary boundary, not a concession: without it the law reads all-functions-are-defects (absurd, would be ignored).
lawNineTestCanon.case3_middle_decisive_test: per-type children BELONG to each type but live in the resolver = VIOLATION. DECISIVE TEST: add a new type — if you must EDIT THE RESOLVER it is a violation (resolver owns what the type should); if you add a new type-CLASS owning its own children method, compliant.
lawNineTestCanon.renderGreenIsNotOwnership: RENDER-GREEN IS NOT OWNERSHIP. Behavioural green (folder appears, AC-device-folder-visible-390) and structural ownership (12->0, AC-folder-children-single-owner + AC-no-surface-derives-children-otherwise) are SEPARATE signals answering different questions; a shared helper would GREEN BOTH while BEING the defect. Neither substitutes for the other. Hardest to hold at the exact moment Tron folder finally appears and everyone wants to call it done — HOLD IT.
